eyebrow.zh: 工業微生物污染控制與管理

title.zh:
解決微生物污染，
守護您的製程與品質
title.en:
Solving microbial contamination,
protecting your process and quality

lead.zh: 從原料進料管理、製程污染控制、成品防腐到環境管控，清泰源協助工廠解決微生物污染引起的疑難雜症，讓生產運作正常化、製品品質更穩定。
lead.en: From raw-material intake and in-process contamination control to finished-product preservation and environmental management, GETX helps factories solve problems caused by microbial contamination — keeping production running smoothly and product quality consistent.
